notes.title: BETA 1.1 RELEASE NOTES
notes.content:
[b]NEW FEATURE:[/b] Ability to skip the scrolling names portion of the credits
[b]NEW FEATURE: [/b]Ability to re-read the last letter you put down by using the new plastic crate next to the letter machine
[b]NEW FEATURE:[/b] Ability to toggle the font to something clearer while reading a letter (Experimental, please report any bugs)
[b]FIX:[/b] Credit Names appeared before the game logo was done displaying
[b]FIX:[/b] Happy Ball no longer getting stuck behind the toilet of doom
[b]FIX:[/b] Collider blocking you from jumping on table was still too small, now it should properly prevent you from jumping on the table (hopefully. Everybody jump, jump, jump!)


You might have to restart Steam to get this update. You can see the current version on the bottom right of the main menu, it should now say "Beta 1.1" or higher there

notes.title: Beta 1.01 Patch
notes.content:
[h1]BETA 1.01 RELEASE NOTES[/h1]

Thank you to all the testers who are finding so many bugs right now. You are actively helping to make this game a great experience for when it releases and I really appreciate it! Here is the first few changes with more to come soon:

[list]
[*][b]FIX:[/b] Fixed a bug where you could get stuck in the toilet and then fall outside of the cell
[*][b]FIX:[/b] Disallowing jumping on top of the table that would lead to potentially fall outside of the cell
[*][b]FIX:[/b] Main Menu showing "Day 101" after beating the game should now say "Day 5" and allow you to replay Day 5 from the beginning when continuing the savegame
[*][b]FIX:[/b] Being able to advance to Day 6 when it doesn't exist (aka forbidden time travel)
[*][b]FEATURE:[/b] You now have the option to go to bed after Midnight even if no letters have been read
[/list]
